points.description: Reservoir routing advantage: it estimates peak reservoir levels during a flood, which helps in designing/constructing overflow channels (spillways) so nearby areas are not submerged during floods. Must state both the peak reservoir level estimate and its use (overflow channels / avoiding submergence of nearby areas).
points.partial_credit: Half if only one part is stated precisely (e.g. estimates peak reservoir level, with no stated use).

points.description: Channel flood routing advantage: it gives the flood-duration profile (hydrograph variation with time along the channel) during a storm, which helps in constructing bridges, controlling transport over channels, or planning bank-side development. Must state both the flood-duration profile and at least one of these uses.
points.partial_credit: Half if only the flood-duration profile or only a use is stated precisely.

rubric.notes: Each of the two advantages (reservoir, channel) is worth 1 mark and must be tied to the correct routing type. Full mark needs the specific benefit (peak reservoir level; flood-duration profile) plus its stated use. Generic statements like "helps control floods" or "predicts floods", or swapping the two types, earn nothing; a wrong claim in a part voids that part.
